reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. $29.99 is more than what I pay now, and with two kids I am not paying extra for a pocket sachet when my gym bag already holds a bottle.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I do not know this brand and I would be paying more for something I do not need.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or below what I pay now, around $22 for the month, or a free sample box that shows me it works better than what I already take.
